## Closed — change merged, both gates green

Gerrit change [2458](https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2458) **MERGED** to main with `LLM-Review +1` (PASS, 1 non-blocking maintainability advisory) and `Verified +1` (CI run 33355909497: pytest ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 + macOS 3.13, lint+typecheck, mutation, module-size, optionality all green). Module-size gate passed — `_mcp_health.py` reduced 859→713 LOC via the `_mcp_serving.py` seam split; the new module is 200 LOC and not flagged near-cap.

Closed `in_progress → closed`, close-class **`preexisting`** (both fixed mechanisms are latent code defects shipped in fd4a's commit 8297083532a3, not a regression and not the deferred capacity/design limitation), completion-verifier gate PASS. Attribution **`caused_by → fd4a-4e91-f179-4932`** recorded (explicit) and signed into the close disposition. `relates_to → 40a7` (deferred capacity/design-limitation) stands; the mis-dedup `duplicates → 6af7` was removed by the orchestrator. Option 2 (MCP_RELEASES_CAP / port pool) left untouched per instructions.
